test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If R ÷ S means that R is the mother of S, R × S means that R is the father of S, R - S means that R is the sister of S, then which of the following expression shows that P is the father of R?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

R ÷ S means that R is the mother of S.

R × S means that R is the father of S.

R - S means that R is the sister of S.

Given relation code:

 
 

 Code
 Relation
 
 

 ÷ 
 Mother
 
 

 × 
 Father
 
 

 -
 Sister
 
 

Find: Which expression shows that P is the Father of R?

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P × Q ÷ R

P is the father of Q, and Q is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc49ade89ff21fd700f7b0380efa4e0e221b42dd3e6fb574b717f7f35321092d.png] 

Here, P is the maternal grandfather of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 2) **Q × P - R

Q is the father of P, and P is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/451800de055d8241557d649d9801ec736e45c22d358c2a91525c6fb2ff568d70.png] 

Here, P is the sister of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **R × Q - P

R is the father of Q, and Q is the sister of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e8b9739a080f666b4ed34a4790b7b89b5e9ed53b6893d0126bf4231c03afe55.png] 

Here, the gender of P is not clear. So we can't find How P is related to R. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **P × Q - R

P is the father of Q, and Q is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26442780a498163dfaf3f214f9d27121602919f416ad14a926ad562952f43a28.png] 

Here, P is the father of R. (Correct)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
